findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 18 in the same format as the Physics 11 chapter practice (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 140 questions numbered 1-140; by section: 18.1 17, 18.2 33, 18.3 20, 18.4 18, 18.5 9, 18.6 8, 18.7 19, 18.8 16. Covers sections 18.1-18.8 in order (photon and quantum theory, photoelectric effect, Compton effect with pair production and annihilation, de Broglie waves and the Davisson-Germer experiment, wave-particle duality, electron microscope, atomic spectra, uncertainty principle). Numericals use values changed from the book's examples and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: phi = hf0 (Eq. 18.6), (h/lambda') cos theta in the x-momentum equation, Compton shift as Eq. 18.8, lambda = h/p (Eq. 18.10), 1/lambda (not h/lambda) in the Rydberg formulas, Lyman series ending on n = 1, momentum in kg m s^-1.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
